name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*.*.*"

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  ci:
    name: CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          cache: true

      - name: Install cargo-audit
        run: cargo install cargo-audit

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Run cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt --check

      - name: Run cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run cargo audit
        run: cargo audit

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --workspace

  release:
    name: Release
    needs: ci
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: crates.io
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          cache: true

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        run: cargo install cargo-binstall

      - name: Install git-cliff
        run: cargo binstall git-cliff --no-confirm

      - name: Generate changelog
        run: git cliff --tag ${{ github.ref_name }} --output CHANGELOG.md

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body_path: CHANGELOG.md
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Build binaries
        run: |
          rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu x86_64-unknown-linux-musl aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu x86_64-apple-darwin aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
          cargo build --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin
          cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Package binaries
        run: |
          cd target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release && tar czf keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz keifu
          cd ../x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release && tar czf keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz keifu
          cd ../aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release && tar czf keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz keifu
          cd ../x86_64-apple-darwin/release && tar czf keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz keifu
          cd ../aarch64-apple-darwin/release && tar czf keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz keifu
          cd ../x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release && zip keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip keifu.exe

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-${{ github.ref_name }}-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload release assets
